title: New Year's Eve at home in Telopea or Old Toongabbie? 100% eggless cake
summary:
Hosting New Year's Eve in Telopea or Old Toongabbie with vegetarian and Jain guests? Every cake from Harris Park is 100% eggless, so the one on the table at midnight is one everybody can eat.

No eggs in the sponge, the buttercream or any of the 15 flavours. Nobody has to ask which slice is safe.

New Year's Eve falls on a Thursday this year. Shop cakes need two days' notice, so order by Tuesday 29 December. A 10-inch serves 20-22 and starts at $74.99; a 12-inch serves 25-30 from $89.99.

Pickup only, from Wigram Street, Harris Park. Holiday hours can change, so confirm your pickup time when you order. 🎆

Midnight arrives on schedule. The cake should too.
